title: Choosing a Tablet
transcript:
Customer: Hi, I'm looking for a tablet, mostly for reading and taking notes in class.
Clerk: Okay. Do you want one that works with a stylus?
Customer: I think so. I hate typing notes on a screen.
Clerk: Then I'd skip this cheaper model. It doesn't support a pen at all.
Customer: Oh. What about the one next to it?
Clerk: That one does, but the pen's sold separately. Even with the pen, it's still less than the premium model.
Customer: Okay, I'll take that one and the pen.

questions.stem: Why does the clerk advise against the cheaper model?
options: It is too heavy to carry to class.
It has a small screen for reading.
It cannot be used with a pen.
It is no longer being made.
questions.explanation: The clerk says the cheaper model "doesn't support a pen at all," and the customer wants a stylus.

questions.stem: How does the woman feel about typing on a screen?
options: She finds it faster than writing.
She thinks it is fine for short notes.
questions.explanation: She says, "I hate typing notes on a screen."
